fr-02-18852.title: 비확산국; 중화인민공화국 및 인도 소재 기관에 대한 비확산 조치 부과
fr-02-18852.orig: Bureau of Nonproliferation; Imposition of Nonproliferation Measures Against Entities in the People's Republic of China and in India
fr-02-18852.quote: "A determination has been made that the following persons have engaged in proliferation activities that require the imposition of measures pursuant to the Iran-Iraq Arms Non-Proliferation Act of 1992 and/or the chemical/biological nonproliferation provisions of the Arms Export Control Act and the Export Administration Act of 1979 (as continued by E.O. 13222 of August 17, 2001)."
fr-02-18852.ko: 다음 당사자들이 1992년 이란·이라크 무기 비확산법 및/또는 무기수출통제법과 1979년 수출관리법(2001. 8. 17.자 행정명령 13222로 효력이 연장됨)의 화학·생물 비확산 조항에 따른 조치의 부과가 요구되는 확산 활동에 관여하였다는 판단이 내려졌다.

fr-03-3956.title: 외국 개인·기관에 대한 미국 정부 조달 금지를 포함한 화학·생물무기 확산 제재 부과
fr-03-3956.orig: Imposition of Chemical and Biological Weapons Proliferation Sanctions Against Foreign Persons, Including a Ban on U.S. Government Procurement
fr-03-3956.quote: "The United States Government has determined that two foreign persons have engaged in chemical/biological weapons proliferation activities that require the imposition of sanctions pursuant to the Arms Export Control Act and the Export Administration Act of 1979 (the authority of which was most recently continued by Executive Order 13222 of August 17, 2001)."
fr-03-3956.ko: 미국 정부는 외국 당사자 2개가 무기수출통제법 및 1979년 수출관리법(그 권한은 2001. 8. 17.자 행정명령 13222로 가장 최근에 연장되었다)에 따른 제재의 부과가 요구되는 화학·생물무기 확산 활동에 관여하였다고 판단하였다.

fr-2020-10869.orig: Addition of Entities to the Entity List, Revision of Certain Entries on the Entity List
fr-2020-10869.quote: "In this rule, the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) amends the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) by adding twenty-four entities, under twenty-five entries, to the Entity List. fr-2024-27337.quote: "The U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS), as the Chair of the Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force (FLETF), announces the publication and availability of the updated Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act (UFLPA) Entity List, a consolidated register of the four lists required to be developed and maintained pursuant to the UFLPA, on the DHS UFLPA website."
